author: levelsio
text:
🇪🇺 Great data and actually I think we should use this kinds of data to completely turn around Europe's immigration policy:

- We should have super easy inflow for immigrants from countries whose previous immigrants have shown low crime rates

You're from Japan? Just fly here and you can stay forever

- We should then almost completely ban any inflow from countries whose previous immigrants have shown high crime rates with instant deportations

You're on the top of that list? You're not coming in, sorry. We have to keep Europeans safe first!

Then you can add special exceptions for people in those worst rated countries for high quality talent, think AI engineers, neurosurgeons, high IQ people, with no crime records. But that process will take a little bit longer than just flying into Europe

Then every year you check the data and you adjust the policy based on last 5 or 10 years of criminal history of immigrants from those places

I think this is the most common sense policy and it'll make Europe much safer
